data.explanation: This is an invoice (Rechnung) from the online shop Beispiel Versand GmbH for a hedge trimmer you ordered on 15.12.2025, bought on account ("Kauf auf Rechnung"). The total amount of 134,98 EUR is due 7 days after the invoice date. Please transfer this amount to the seller's IBAN shown on the invoice, quoting the invoice number BV-7741203 as the payment reference (Verwendungszweck), by the deadline shown. If you don't pay in time, the seller could send a reminder (Mahnung) and add late fees, so it's best to pay promptly or contact them if there's an issue with the order.
